title: Jaws
author: Peter Benchley
summary: A great white shark begins killing swimmers off a New England resort town, and the police chief wants the beaches closed while the mayor and the businesses push to stay open for the season.
readIf: you want a fast, nasty creature thriller with a lot of small-town politics around the shark.
skipIf: you expect the film's tone; the book has more subplots and bleaker characters.

pairings.reason: Another fast monster thriller where greed and human error cause the disaster.
The great literary ancestor of men and sea creatures locked in a fatal obsession.
A short, quiet story of one man and a huge fish, with more heart and less panic.
